claim: Patchline ships a marketplace of community gates with signing, review, and reproducibility requirements. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the signing claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make community-gate-marketplace-gate`.
